doc_title: APPLICATION TO BE NOTED IN THE REGISTER AS A SPOUSE
doc_title_official: APPLICATION TO BE NOTED IN THE REGISTER AS A SPOUSE
when_used: A spouse of the registered proprietor applies to have the spousal interest noted in the register of the title.

detail_rows.label: Address for Service of Applicant (Note that the address(es) will be entered in the register and used for correspondence and the service of notice):

body_text.text: The Applicant as a spouse of the registered proprietor HEREBY APPLIES to be noted in the register as a spouse.
In support of this Application the Applicant has attached a statutory declaration and supporting documents.

Note: If you dishonestly enter information or make a statement that you know is, or might be, untrue or misleading, and intend by doing so to make a gain for yourself or another person, or to cause loss or the risk of loss to another person, you may commit the offence of fraud.

execution.verification_heading: Certificate of Verification under Section 45 of the Land Registration Act

annex.heading: STATUTORY DECLARATION
annex.intro: I, {{declarant_name}} (in support of this Application) do hereby sincerely declare as follows:-
body_lines: THAT I am the spouse of the {{proprietor_spouse_of}}
the registered proprietor by virtue of the following:
closing_lines: I attach the following supporting documents:
A duly certified copy of a marriage certificate dated {{marriage_certificate_date}} under the {{marriage_law}};
A copy of the search report in respect of the property.
annex.closing: I make this declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true and according to the Oaths and Statutory Declaration Act.
annex.jurat_signatory: Signature of Commissioner for Oaths or Magistrate or Notary Public

custom_fields.name: registered_proprietor
custom_fields.label: Registered proprietor
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the registered proprietor of the title, as the register shows it

custom_fields.name: applicant_address_for_service
custom_fields.label: Address for service of the Applicant
custom_fields.prompt: Postal and physical address of the applicant spouse. It is entered in the register and used for correspondence and for serving notices

custom_fields.name: applicant_email
custom_fields.label: Email of the Applicant
custom_fields.prompt: Email address of the applicant spouse

custom_fields.name: applicant_telephone
custom_fields.label: Telephone number of the Applicant
custom_fields.prompt: Telephone number of the applicant spouse

custom_fields.name: declarant_name
custom_fields.label: Name of the declarant
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the person swearing the statutory declaration in support of this application

custom_fields.name: proprietor_spouse_of
custom_fields.label: The registered proprietor the Applicant is married to
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the registered proprietor the applicant is the spouse of, as the register shows it

custom_fields.name: marriage_certificate_date
custom_fields.label: Date of the marriage certificate
custom_fields.prompt: Date on the certified copy of the marriage certificate attached to the declaration

custom_fields.name: marriage_law
custom_fields.label: Law the marriage was celebrated under
custom_fields.prompt: The name of the law the marriage certificate was issued under. The form already prints "under the" before this, so give just the Act's name with no leading "the", for example Marriage Act, 2014

custom_fields.name: further_supporting_document
custom_fields.label: Further supporting document
custom_fields.prompt: Any other document attached in support of the declaration, or leave it out where there is none

custom_fields.name: declaration_text
custom_fields.label: Marriage particulars
custom_fields.prompt: The particulars of the marriage that support this declaration, one paragraph per line, for example the date and place of the marriage and how it was contracted
